lines.text: [deadpan] [long pause] A social network for photographs of lunch. [pause] I have seen the first version of this idea. It was called a camera roll.
lines.sourceNote: Public interviews on focus and taste

lines.text: [interrupting] [dry laugh] The unit economics are a sandwich. Revenue per user is a sandwich. [pause] What is the limiting factor here? Appetite?
lines.sourceNote: Public talks on first principles reasoning

lines.text: [softly] Okay, look, I wanna be fair here. [pause] Who's your first hundred users? [pause] [sighs] Yeah. The people who were already in the room. And they're leaving.
[sharply] And whose fault is this? You two keep telling founders to just ship it. [pause] Look at what ships.
lines.sourceNote: Public interviews on focus and taste

lines.text: [overlapping] [laughs awkwardly] Okay. I am out. [pause] Someone call me when physics gets involved.
lines.sourceNote: Comedy beat, not a sourced principle.

verdict.summary: The council has seen worse ideas, but only in a previous life.
verdict.roast: This is not a product. It is a screenshot with a business model attached. The only thing here that scales is the disappointment.
